title: Organization Unit Wage Account Groups — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
Which wage account group an organisation unit uses, from a given date.

Not read at present: the cost engine and the journal voucher take their accounts from each employee's own wage accounts, and nothing reads this assignment. It is kept for reference and for future use.

fields.label: OrganizationUnitId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Organization Unit master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The organisation unit.

Example. Finance Department

fields.label: WageAccGroupId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wage Acc Group master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The wage account group the unit uses from the start date.

Example. Head Office Accounts

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Saving closes the previous record for the same organization unit on the day before this date; the latest record stays open.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.
